Read-only research task against Confluence (zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net, space SFCC). Do NOT modify/create/comment on anything. If mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_* tools are deferred, load via ToolSearch: "select:mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page,mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_comments,mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_search".

BACKGROUND: Page 346783750 ("Contentful Integration Technical Design & Content Model (SFCC-249)") has a disputed rule in section 5.5 splitting Contentful components into "Studio Experience" (Contentful's drag-and-drop Experience Builder, currently used for Z.immerse/campaign pages) versus "coded content-type component" (hand-built, for fixed slots: homepage/footer/nav/PLP/PDP/announcement banner/size guide). Tim Lavelle (Solution Architect) left two inline comments pushing back: one questioning whether the two-path split is needed at all ("the components we build will most of the time being used in an experience builder"), and one on the Heuristic bullet ("Authors will place elements on a page"). NOTE: the page's `confluence_get_comments` tool has previously returned a STALE/OLD comment set that did NOT include newer inline comments - if that happens again, use confluence_search instead to find comments by title "Re: Contentful Integration Technical Design & Content Model (SFCC-249)" and fetch by page_id from the search results, which has worked previously.

TASK:
1. Fetch page 346783750 fresh (convert_to_markdown=true) and get its CURRENT version number and the exact current text of section 5.5 (Authoring-path rule + Heuristic). Has it changed since the last known state (should currently still say "does the author decide placement and neighbours? Studio Experience...")?
2. Find ALL current inline comments on this page (use confluence_search with query similar to: title ~ "Re: Contentful Integration Technical Design" if confluence_get_comments returns stale data). Specifically look for: (a) any NEW reply on the two Studio-vs-coded threads (comment ids were approximately 379617282-area for the drift one, and separate ones for the "I'm not sure we need to separate these" and "Authors will place elements on a page" comments) since 2026-08-01, (b) any reply from Jhoan, Marcel, or Tim continuing that specific conversation.
3. Broad fresh search: confluence_search for text ~ "Experience Builder" OR text ~ "Studio Experience" OR text ~ "component library" OR text ~ "flexible component" OR text ~ "page composition" across the whole SFCC space - report ALL hits, not just the ones already known (318472193, 256835585, 258801666, 303071234 HPC-010). Flag if anything NEW shows up that wasn't found in a prior pass.
4. Re-check page 258801666 (04.2 Design Tracker) for the Z.immerse "flexible content components" row - any change or new detail?
5. Re-check HPC-010 on page 303071234 ("reusable page builder templates across page types") - any clarifying comment or update since it was last checked?

Report back with explicit VERIFIED/CHANGED/NEW/NO-CHANGE verdicts, citing page-id and exact quotes. Do not speculate about what things mean, just report what is currently there.

## Findings — Confluence space SFCC, page 346783750 (Contentful Integration Technical Design & Content Model, SFCC-249)

**Note on tooling:** `confluence_get_comments` reproduced the known staleness bug — it returned only 24 comments, all with IDs ≤ 354910215, missing everything created since roughly Sprint 2 (comment IDs 355xxx through 381xxx, ~20+ comments). The title-based `confluence_search` workaround (`title ~ "Re: ..."`) failed silently (empty result, likely due to the `&` in the title breaking CQL). What worked: `confluence_search` with `type=comment AND container=346783750`, which returned the complete, current comment list including everything up to the newest comment (381321223). Recommend that CQL form as the reliable go-forward workaround.

### 1. Page fetch — version and Section 5.5 text

**VERIFIED — Confluence page version is 40** (fetched fresh, `convert_to_markdown=true`). Note: the document's own internal "Version" metadata field still reads `v31 - Draft (reformatted from v30)` — the version-history table hasn't been updated to reflect the ~9 platform-version bumps since, which are all comment-driven edits (see below).

**NO CHANGE — Section 5.5 "Authoring-path rule" is unchanged.** Current exact text:

> "**Heuristic:** does the author decide placement and neighbours? Studio Experience. Does the dev fix placement and the author only fill fields? Coded component."

The full rule (Studio Experience vs. coded content-type component definitions, the Z.immerse/campaign-page canonical example, and the "Build the coded version by default..." rider about `shoppableImage`) is word-for-word what was previously known. The disputed split has not been revised or removed in the document body despite Tim's pushback comments below.
